title: Quality is a mixed bag
text: This last box was a disappointment.  Glasses were not shatterproof as advertised and was decorated with a very cheap sticker that is already falling apart.  Salt and pepper shaker came with two pepper tops.  Wrote the seller and they stated all came that way and no way to fix.  Really?  You can "fix" it by rebate the cost of those items!  Not sure how much longer we will keep this subscription if this type of quality issues and poor customer service continue.
label: negative
